DeepSeek V4 Flash uses persistent KV caches for sliding-window attention (SWA), C4, and C128. The native FP8 layout uses 584 bytes per latent KV row, which limits KV-cache capacity for long-context workloads.

```bash
--kv-cache-dtype int4

title: [Perf][DSpark] lossless improve DSpark throughput by W2 matrix topk pruned
body_opening:
## Purpose
According to the work and research of DFlash2, the vast majority of the probability mass at each position in the draft model is concentrated on a small set of top-k tokens.   

For the Markov matrix B = W1 @ W2 in DSpark's speculative decoding process, W2 has a shape of [rank, full vocab].
